current_scenario.important_route_warning: The same total dose is currently applied to every route. This is not acceptable for interpreting local-CNS safety without route-specific dose calibration.

zolgensma_iv.evidence_kind: marketed-product dose with serious known risks
zolgensma_iv.interpretation: Same route and capsid as IV AAV9, but different payload, manufacturing, age and disease. The dose is not a universal safe threshold.

zolgensma_mouse_histology_signal.evidence_kind: lowest explicitly reported cardiac histology signal dose; not a NOAEL
zolgensma_mouse_histology_signal.interpretation: Neonatal-mouse product-specific signal. Directly relevant to heart and supportive for liver hazard identification; not an all-organ human threshold.

itvisma_it.evidence_kind: marketed-product dose with serious known risks
itvisma_it.interpretation: Same route and capsid as lumbar intrathecal AAV9, but different payload, manufacturing, population and procedure. The dose is not a universal safe threshold.

kebilidi_intraputaminal.evidence_kind: marketed local-CNS product dose and procedure context
kebilidi_intraputaminal.interpretation: Four stereotactic putaminal infusions totaling 0.32 mL. The current model has no intraparenchymal compartment, so this case is not used as an exposure threshold.

sineup_gdnf_mouse.evidence_kind: mechanism and local tolerability proof of concept; not GLP toxicology
sineup_gdnf_mouse.interpretation: 1 uL of 7.0e12 vg/mL AAV9; about two-fold endogenous GDNF increase for at least six months with no reported body-weight or food-intake signal. Target- and species-specific.

itvisma_nhp_low_dose.evidence_kind: lowest NHP IT dose with microscopic neural findings; not a NOAEL
itvisma_nhp_low_dose.interpretation: Minimal-to-moderate microscopic CNS/DRG/nerve findings occurred at all tested doses, including 1.2e13 vg/NHP. No clinical correlate; CSF scaling was used for human context.

itvisma_clinical_safety.product: ITVISMA randomized and open-label clinical safety database
itvisma_clinical_safety.evidence_kind: clinical adverse-reaction frequencies at marketed dose
itvisma_clinical_safety.interpretation: At 1.2e14 vg: hepatic-enzyme increase 6/75 (8%), thrombocytopenia 3/75 (4%), sensory disturbance 2/75 (3%); two ALT values reached 20x ULN.

spinraza_it_rna.interpretation: Useful for lumbar-puncture procedure and monitoring context; mass cannot be converted to vg.

qalsody_it_rna.interpretation: Useful for lumbar-puncture procedure and route-specific hazards; mass cannot be converted to vg.

roctavian_iv.evidence_kind: approved AAV5 systemic-dose context with required liver monitoring
roctavian_iv.interpretation: Same capsid and route for IV AAV5, but a different liver-directed cassette, product, manufacturing process and population. Historical approved-dose context is not a NOAEL.

aav8_hemophilia_iv.evidence_kind: clinical AAV8 systemic dose with 13-year follow-up
aav8_hemophilia_iv.interpretation: Same capsid family and systemic route for IV AAV8; small hemophilia cohort and a liver-specific cassette do not establish a general-organ safety threshold.

lk03_hemophilia_iv.product: SPK-8011 AAV-LK03 hemophilia A phase 1-2 study
lk03_hemophilia_iv.interpretation: Same engineered capsid and route, but immune events and glucocorticoid use occurred; the dose is a clinical context rather than a no-effect threshold.

glybera_im.evidence_kind: human intramuscular AAV route context; authorization later withdrawn
glybera_im.interpretation: Route-matched but cross-capsid and historical. Genome copies and vector genomes are treated as an approximate modeling bridge, not an assay-equivalent conversion.

aav2_cf_aerosol.evidence_kind: human route- and capsid-matched repeated aerosol dose context
aav2_cf_aerosol.interpretation: Three administrations were studied 30 days apart. Particle and vg assays, cassette, nebulizer deposition and lung disease prevent direct threshold equivalence.

aavrh10_intracerebral.interpretation: Twelve direct parenchymal deposits with immunosuppression are not equivalent to IT, ICM or ICV administration; retained as qualitative AAVrh.10 evidence only.

important_limits: A marketed dose is not a universal safe threshold.
The 7.9e13 vg/kg mouse signal dose is not a NOAEL and is not an all-organ human threshold.
The model has no calibrated exposure-to-ALT, TMA, troponin or DRG injury function.
The model has no DRG compartment and no immune/complement state.
Vector genome, capsid particle, empty/full ratio, promoter, payload, impurities, age and disease change risk.
The final plasmid sequence, target isoform, promoter and human off-target screen are not present in the repository.
Evidence haircuts (0.75, 0.10 or 0.03, with an additional mouse-restricted capsid penalty) are transparent modeling policy factors, not literature-derived probabilities.
The two-fold SINEUP activity factor is a sensitivity assumption informed by the approximate miniSINEUP-GDNF proof-of-concept gain; it does not calibrate a human effective dose.
A below-bound result means below a conservative contextual exposure projection, not clinically proven safe.

dose_window_method.pk_scaling: Organ AUC is scaled approximately linearly from the 2.8e15-vg anchor trajectory.
dose_window_method.reference_projection: The active PBPK model projects organ AUC at a disclosed human or route-nearest dose context.
dose_window_method.evidence_haircut: A transparent factor reduces that contextual AUC before it is used as an exploratory upper bound.
dose_window_method.efficacy: A three-state Epi-SINEUP RNA-protein ODE is re-solved from the dose-scaled normalized peak episome signal.
dose_window_method.decision_rule: A model-feasible window requires protein >=65% and all modeled organ AUCs below their conservative contextual upper bounds.

liver.monitoring: ALT, AST, total bilirubin, albumin, PT/INR; liver histology and cytokines preclinically

renal_tma.hazard: Complement-associated thrombotic microangiopathy and acute kidney injury
renal_tma.monitoring: Platelets, hemoglobin, creatinine, urinalysis, LDH/haptoglobin and complement markers

cardiac.monitoring: Troponin and cardiac assessment when biologically or clinically indicated

cns_drg.hazard: DRG or local CNS neurotoxicity, especially for CSF/local routes
cns_drg.monitoring: Neurological/sensory endpoints, MRI, CSF markers and DRG histopathology in relevant animals

systemic_immune.hazard: Innate/adaptive immune activation and loss of efficacy
systemic_immune.monitoring: Pre-existing NAb, anti-capsid antibody/T cells, cytokines, complement and infection status

screens.interpretation: Research-use dose-window and assay-priority screen. The conservative bound is a haircut applied to a PBPK-projected disclosed-dose context; it is not a NOAEL, clinical recommendation or adverse-event probability.
